title: STORY COLLECTION EVENT: A DEATH IN CHUNFEN
lines: 01 NEW STORY COLLECTION EVENT: A DEATH IN CHUNFEN
DURATION: August 22, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) - September 1, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
EVENT STAGES DURATION: August 22, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) - August 29, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10
EVENT STAGES MAINLY DROP: Wellbeing Charms, Materials, etc.

DETAILS: A Death in Chunfen event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain Wellbeing Charms by clearing all the stages except Annihilation and Extreme Mode to redeem event rewards and Information Fragments at the Yishan Temple. Information Fragments can be used to unlock the stories in Story Collection.
[YISHAN TEMPLE] DURATION: August 22, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) - September 1, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[YISHAN TEMPLE] MAIN REWARDS: EPOQUE Cambrian Series - Melodic Portrayal for Deepcolor, Information Fragments, Module Materials, Elite Materials, Battle Records, LMD, Recruitment Permits, etc.
NOTE: During this event, the event stories cannot be reviewed in Special Operation. After the event ends, the event stories will be recorded in Special Operation.
02 LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING OPEN – SPRINGTIDE SNOWFALL
DURATION: August 22, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) - September 5, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, the Limited-time Headhunting, [Springtide Snowfall], opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate from this Standard Headhunting:
★★★★★★: Qiubai
★★★★★: Wind Chimes / Hung
03 NEW OPERATORS AVAILABLE
DETAILS: The following Operators will appear at Headhunting [SPRINGTIDE SNOWFALL], and will be permanently added to other Headhuntings in future update.
★★★★★★: Qiubai
★★★★★: Wind Chimes
NOTE:
- Operator Qiubai and Wind Chimes will gain more trust during this event.

CHUNFEN CHIP PACK

08 LIMITED-TIME EVENT: #02 TRIALS FOR NAVIGATOR OPEN
DURATION: August 31, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) - September 7, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10

DETAILS: Trials for Navigator event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, completing Trial Tasks to earn Trial EXP, and increasing the level of Path of Trials.
[PATH OF TRIALS] DURATION: August 31, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) - September 10, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
MAIN REWARDS: 0011 Series - Fragrance From the Branches for Blacknight, Headhunting Permit, Module Materials, Elite Materials, Battle Records, LMD, Furniture Parts, and more.
09 RECORD RESTORATION: VIGILO
UPDATE TIME: August 29, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The Record Restoration of Vigilo will be open after the next update. The limited event rewards will be permanently available for players to unlock.

UPDATE TIME: September 1, 2023, 04:00 (UTC-7)
